proposals.before: The rulers of India and Maragha came to court.
proposals.after: The rulers of India and Mulahi came to court.
proposals.reason: 木羅夷 denotes the Mulahi (Nizari Assassin) polity, not the city Maragha.

proposals.before: The rulers of India and Maragha came to court.
proposals.after: The rulers of India and Mulahi came to court.
proposals.reason: Same error in the literal: 木羅夷 is Mulahi, not Maragha.

proposals.before: In the sixth year (jiawu), in the first month of spring, the Jin emperor abdicated in favor of the clansman Chen Lin, then hanged himself and was burned.
proposals.after: In the sixth year (jiawu), in the first month of spring, the Jin emperor abdicated in favor of the clansman Chenglin, then hanged himself and was burned.
proposals.reason: 承麟 is Chenglin, not the Mandarin misreading Chen Lin.

proposals.before: When the city fell, Chen Lin was captured and killed.
proposals.after: When the city fell, Chenglin was captured and killed.
proposals.reason: 承麟 should be Chenglin for consistency with the Chinese.

proposals.before: That winter, in the tenth month, Yelü Ahai was put in charge of Han commoners' affairs.
proposals.after: That winter, in the tenth month, Yalavach was put in charge of Han commoners' affairs.
proposals.reason: 牙老瓦赤 is Yalavach (Mahmud Yalavach), not Yelü Ahai.

proposals.before: In the tenth month of winter, Yelü Ahai was ordered to supervise Han commoners' affairs.
proposals.after: In the tenth month of winter, Yalavach was ordered to supervise Han commoners' affairs.
proposals.reason: Same mistranslation of 牙老瓦赤 as Yelü Ahai.

proposals.before: Ma Bojian, Jin's garrison commander for Jincheng, surrendered; he was given a Jin tally of office and ordered to hold the place.
proposals.after: Ma Bojian, Jin's garrison defense controller, surrendered; he was given a golden tally of office and ordered to hold the place.
proposals.reason: 防城提控 is a defense-controller office title, not a posting at a place named Jincheng; 金符 is a golden tally, not a Jin-dynasty tally.

proposals.before: In the ninth month of autumn Prince Kökejin captured Song's Grand Marshal He.
proposals.after: In the ninth month of autumn Prince Köten Buqa captured Song's Grand Marshal He.
proposals.reason: 口溫不花 is Köten Buqa (as elsewhere in this chapter), not Kökejin.

decisions.reason: s0209 has 木羅夷國主; 木羅夷 is the Mulahi polity, not Maragha, so the proposed replacement is correct.
The literal likewise misreads 木羅夷 as Maragha; Mulahi matches the Chinese.
承麟 is Chenglin; Chen Lin invents a different name not supported by the Chinese.
s0063 again names 承麟; Chenglin is the accurate reading, not Chen Lin.
牙老瓦赤 is Yalavach; Yelü Ahai (耶律阿海) is a different person and unsupported here.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 命牙老瓦赤主管漢民公事

decisions.reason: The literal repeats the same wrong identity for 牙老瓦赤; Yalavach is correct.
金防城提控 is Jin's city-defense controller office, not a Jincheng posting; 金符 is a golden tally, not a Jin-dynasty tally.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 金防城提控馬伯堅降，授伯堅金符

decisions.reason: 諸王口溫不花 is Köten Buqa (same Chinese used later in this chapter); Kökejin is unsupported.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepted r0008 shows English Prince Kökejin came only from the bad idiomatic of 諸王口溫不花; the title claim must read Prince Köten Buqa while keeping zh, id, subject, predicate, certainty, and evidence.
